Volunteer

Come as you are. Stay as long as you like.

No experience needed and no long commitments. Most of our volunteers give a couple of hours a month, and every one of them started by saying hello.

Ways to help

  • Pantry evenings

    Unpack deliveries, stock the shelves and welcome people in.

    2 hours, once or twice a month

  • Garden mornings

    Dig, sow, water and share what you know with new growers.

    Saturday mornings, spring to autumn

  • Beach care

    Walk the shoreline with the Shoreline Keepers and record what you find.

    First Sunday of the month

  • Lantern Rides driver

    Drive a neighbor to an appointment and keep them company while they wait.

    Flexible, booked ahead
